inventory_integrity.scope: immutable local events, normalized attempts and raw-file hashes

limitations: 2 paired runs per concurrency with balanced AB/BA order; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals or significance tests.
8-request p95/p99 estimates and smaller stratum tails have limited resolution; correlated requests are not independent replicate runs.
Client chunk receipts do not establish individual token emission times or engine-internal latency.
Generated structured-record tasks do not establish general language competence; frozen splits and separate code are workflow separation, not malicious-writer isolation.

Changed-input comparisons require both arms to pass 95% exact task quality with no observed pairwise quality loss; output/token differences remain visible. A syntactic dependency certificate cannot guarantee model output.

Primary practical-gain classification uses full attempt wall including input transformation/tokenization, hashing, startup and shutdown; service-only throughput is descriptive. Shared setup/search allocation cost is added by the inventory report.
All supplied attempts are retained; this file alone cannot prove omitted attempts do not exist.
Digest consistency does not authenticate externally supplied observations.
Attempt-only evaluation does not verify complete inventory or acquisition/build costs.
Offered arrivals and local queue decisions remain in the quality and SLO-fraction denominator; missing requests cannot improve goodput.
Results apply to the declared arrival trace and device; finite batches do not imply online serving, energy or cross-device superiority.

native_evidence_integrity.scope: Raw/native/transformation consistency; local hashes do not establish independent authenticity.

evaluation.deadline_policy: expire_before_dispatch; in-flight completion lateness retained and evaluated against SLOs
evaluation.uncertainty: descriptive_pair_range; request-level paired quality differences, no independence claim

ablations: Full context without cache versus full context with cache: prefix-cache-v1.
Uncached full context versus uncached dependency slice: dependency-slice-v1.
Both arms cached: slice-versus-full-cache-v1, the primary strong comparator.
research_protocol.baseline: Complete original record table with same-slot prefix caching enabled; candidate uses dependency slice with caching also enabled. Each arm has its own real cold-start history.
research_protocol.claim_limit: Instrumented CPU cache-compression interaction and model-transfer study; substantial known prior-art overlap; novelty unestablished; this eight-request development case cannot establish measurement eligibility, broad natural-language quality, energy savings, API-price equivalence or novelty.
research_protocol.confirmation_isolation: Separate modules, candidate receives prompt only, regenerated fixed answers, distinct seeded split, frozen implementation hashes. Shared Unix identity: workflow convention, not an adversarial security boundary.
research_protocol.development_evidence: Root reports0.5B reference-chain/context8 only1/8correctperarm; quality investigator reportslookup/context8 6/8perarm. These are warning signals, not outcomes of the newly frozen repeated-table population.
research_protocol.hypothesis: Repeated-table full-context caching can reuse the original table prefix across changing queries, while query-dependent dependency slices can destroy that reuse. Shorter prompts may then have no quality-qualified full-cost advantage; actual native histories, not API prices or two hypothetical simultaneous caches, decide.
research_protocol.question: When do context omission savings disappear against full-context prefix caching under repeated tables, longer contexts, arrivals and model transfer?
research_protocol.selection_rule: Require each full-context baseline attempt at least95% exact task accuracy (8/8 in eight-request feasibility). If baseline fails, preserve complete adverse study and do not launch small-model confirmations. Any harmful omission remains visible.
research_protocol.stopping_rule: Exactly frozen cells once. No automatic rerun, no filtering baseline failures, no gate relaxation. Stop before request/time/globaldeadline caps. Failed/interrupted native attempts retain costs and cancel remaining confirmation cells.
research_protocol.uncertainty: Two balanced AB/BA pairs; descriptive pair ranges only. Eight-query shared-table trajectories are dependent. No request-IID confidence or cross-device/population claim.
